name: Family Workshop Bopl
description: All requested mods available to try. Gameplay-changing additions are disabled initially; enable the same selection on all family PCs. F8 shared colors; F9 trajectory visibility. AcidTrip includes flashing colors and is disabled.

mods.description: An actively spinning drill wins confirmed Bounce Ball contact; scaled attack hitboxes cut balls too. All players need the same mod. Gameplay testing is pending.
